name: Nakashima Nana
source: A girl who claims to be a vampire, has sharp fangs, sleeps inside a coffin and wears gothic clothing. She gets easily flustered and is scared of ghosts. Since she doesn't go to school she spends most of her time taking care of the house with [url=/c7861]Yui[/url].
